verdict.rationale: Free public document generators or downloadable startup forms are a fair axis for a law firm, but nothing in the pack shows CAM offers incorporation templates, SAFEs/term sheets, or NDAs to non-clients. The Legaltech page only says the firm advises startups on standardizing their key documents, which is client advisory work. The free blogs are thought-leadership commentary, not forms, and Prarambh is a selective incubator cohort, not an open document library.
